async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the searchbox to filter projects by name
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("prism-theme")
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the page to update after filtering
    # Check if the project 'prism-theme' appears in the filtered list
    # Look for a link with the exact name 'prism-theme' or similar in the headings
    # Since the tree shows project links under headings, I'll try to find a heading or link containing 'prism-theme'
    try:
        # First, try to find a link with the exact name 'prism-theme'
        project_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="prism-theme", exact=True)
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Wait for the project details page to load
    except Exception as e:
        # If not found, try a case-insensitive substring match in the headings or links
        project_link = page.get_by_role("heading").filter(has_text="prism-theme").get_by_role("link")
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
